checks: Queen can now carry from outside into the opposing box.
An actual entry keeps controlled possession and consumes the existing carrying allowance.
Inside-box movement permits four entered squares, costing eight points; five remain illegal.
The four goal-front cells remain keeper-only.
A king still cannot enter the opposing box.
Collecting an own loose pass inside the box from outside remains illegal.
Pass-and-run still cannot enter the box.
The fifth carrying round is stopped before box entry and awards the opponent an indirect free kick.
